name: agency_id
description: Unique identifier for a transit agency

name: agency_name
description: Full name of the transit agency

name: agency_url
description: URL of the transit agency's website

name: agency_timezone
description: Timezone where the transit agency is located (IANA timezone name)

name: agency_lang
description: Primary language used by the agency (ISO 639-1 two-letter code)

name: agency_phone
description: Voice telephone number for the transit agency

name: route_id
description: Unique identifier for a transit route

name: route_short_name
description: Short public-facing name for the route (e.g., '38', 'N-Judah')

name: route_long_name
description: Full name of the route describing its path or destination

name: route_type
description: Type of transportation used on the route (0=tram, 1=subway, 2=rail, 3=bus, 4=ferry)

name: route_color
description: Color assigned to the route for display purposes (hex code without #)

name: route_text_color
description: Legible text color for route labels displayed against route_color (hex code)

name: route_desc
description: Description of the route's purpose or path

name: route_url
description: URL for a page about the specific route

name: trip_id
description: Unique identifier for a trip (a sequence of stops at specific times)

name: service_id
description: Identifier for the set of dates a trip runs (links to calendar.txt)

name: trip_headsign
description: Text shown on signage identifying the trip's destination to riders

name: direction_id
description: Direction of travel (0=outbound, 1=inbound)

name: block_id
description: Identifier for the block a trip belongs to (for vehicle scheduling)

name: shape_id
description: Identifier for the geographic shape of the trip's path

name: stop_id
description: Unique identifier for a transit stop or station

name: stop_name
description: Public-facing name of the stop or station

name: stop_lat
description: Latitude of the stop location in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: stop_lon
description: Longitude of the stop location in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: stop_desc
description: Description of the stop location to help riders identify it

name: stop_url
description: URL for a page about the specific stop

name: location_type
description: Type of stop location (0=stop, 1=station, 2=entrance/exit, 3=generic node, 4=boarding area)

name: parent_station
description: Stop ID of the station that this stop or entrance belongs to

name: wheelchair_boarding
description: Wheelchair accessibility at this stop (0=no info, 1=accessible, 2=not accessible)

name: stop_sequence
description: Order of the stop within a trip (positive integers, increasing along the trip)

name: arrival_time
description: Scheduled arrival time at the stop in HH:MM:SS (may exceed 24:00:00 for post-midnight trips)

name: departure_time
description: Scheduled departure time from the stop in HH:MM:SS

name: pickup_type
description: Method of pickup at the stop (0=regular, 1=no pickup, 2=must phone, 3=must coordinate)

name: drop_off_type
description: Method of drop-off at the stop (0=regular, 1=no drop-off, 2=must phone, 3=must coordinate)

name: shape_dist_traveled
description: Distance traveled along the shape from the start to this stop (in units defined by shapes.txt)

name: date
description: Date in YYYYMMDD format (used in calendar_dates.txt)

name: exception_type
description: Indicates whether service is added or removed on a date (1=added, 2=removed)

name: monday
description: Whether service runs on Mondays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: tuesday
description: Whether service runs on Tuesdays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: wednesday
description: Whether service runs on Wednesdays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: thursday
description: Whether service runs on Thursdays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: friday
description: Whether service runs on Fridays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: saturday
description: Whether service runs on Saturdays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: sunday
description: Whether service runs on Sundays in the date range (1=yes, 0=no)

name: start_date
description: Start of the service date range in YYYYMMDD format

name: end_date
description: End of the service date range in YYYYMMDD format

name: fare_id
description: Unique identifier for a fare class

name: price
description: Fare price in the currency specified by currency_type

name: currency_type
description: ISO 4217 currency code for the fare price (e.g., USD)

name: payment_method
description: When fare must be paid (0=on board, 1=before boarding)

name: transfers
description: Number of transfers permitted on this fare (0=none, 1=one, 2=two, empty=unlimited)

name: transfer_duration
description: Length of time in seconds before a transfer expires

name: shape_pt_lat
description: Latitude of a shape point in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: shape_pt_lon
description: Longitude of a shape point in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: shape_pt_sequence
description: Order of a point within a shape (positive integers, increasing along the route)
